title: execute or deny rollback drill with separate approval and support recovery binding

criteria: Rollback execution requires controlled activation evidence and separate exact rollback approval.

Rollback evidence binds previous artifact set, activated artifact set, rollback baseline, target ids, rollback PlanSpec, SecurityExecution effect envelope, support/recovery references, audit journal, and post-rollback observations.
Support/recovery remains redacted and no support upload or remote dispatch is performed unless explicitly proved by gates.
